panels.headline: Eli, I'm here for you.
panels.body: A quiet note after your father's loss, with room for grief, silence, and steady care.

panels.body: I am so sorry about your father. I will not try to explain the loss or fill the silence with easy words; I just want you to know you are not alone.

panels.body: I am here for the practical things too: meals, rides, calls, and silence when talking is too much. May you have room to grieve at your own pace, with steady care nearby. With sympathy and friendship, Jordan.
